# OCR fixtures: one page per writing system

Rendered pages (Chromium, Noto / Nanum fonts) with the text and the
box of every line beside them, for the test `other_scripts_are_read`
in `src/providers/ocr_ppocr.rs`: `japanese` is read by the standard
model, the others by the model of their script
(`src/providers/ocr_scripts.rs`).
